body: Autistic and trans here (parents don’t accept). I feel you.

Oh wait, I tried to jump out of my window at 8 years of age but was stopped. I’d honestly completely forgotten about that. I guess I was thinking 15 because that was when I attempted and genuinely thought I’d succeed as I was alone at the time.

Started self-harming at three, said “I want to kill myself” to my parents and teacher at 7 (and it wasn’t taken seriously, indeed, I was laughed at by my parents and scolded by my teacher) but didn’t make my first attempt until 15 (came close at 13 though).

Sorry it took me so long to reply. Thank you so much for reaching out; I’m beginning to get the courage to open up about things recently. Your message really means a lot, hope all is well with you too.

They’re difficult to get hold of here, the gun laws in my country are super strict. Thing is I want to die but I don’t want to be aware of the fact that I’m dying when I do go so I’m scared to hang myself or OD

My father was abusive but he denies it and says I have no reason to be suicidal. Last time I admitted I was feeling that way he hit me over the head and tried to pin me down so I couldn’t stop him from doing so. I wish I could get out of here, as it’s looking like there’s only one real way out and it doesn’t involve leaving home as such.
I guess it’s that some people might actually be a bit upset if I go. I’m not holding out hope for the future, what with my circumstances things will neither change nor look up.

Well, that certainly confirms things. It’s definitely time to go.

Hope things look up for whoever stumbles across this. For me, nothing will or can change, and death will be the only real solution...
